# Open Agent Index

> A dated, transparent ranking of self-hostable agent tools for five business functions. Collected 2026-11-19. Scores come from research evidence: public documentation, repository data, licence files and independent reviews.

Method by Jonathan Duque (https://jonathanduque.com/). Scores come from published evidence only: documentation, repositories, licences, project health, independent reviews. GitHub stars are shown on the page and are not scored. Components: Research evidence (weight 0.35); Owner fit (weight 0.3); Project health (weight 0.25); Licence clarity (weight 0.1). Licence classes are labelled exactly (OSI-approved open source, fair-code, source-available, mixed). Assistant answers are reported next to the ranking and never scored.

- [Scheduling and intake](https://openagentindex.com/scheduling-intake/): 10 tools ranked
- [Back office](https://openagentindex.com/back-office/): 14 tools ranked
- [Reporting and content](https://openagentindex.com/reporting-content/): 22 tools ranked
